COD.note: Only says the central bank and telecoms authorities have begun coordinating on interoperability and standards; no mandate drafting, licensing or switch stated.
Says only that consumer protection mechanisms are weak; no rules or complaints body stated.
Says literacy programmes are rare; no programme or measured share of basic digital skills stated.
Only about half of adults own a mobile phone is stated, an adults-only figure that is not used.

facts.fact: A University of Kinshasa economist's paper, citing the World Bank's Global Findex, says formal account ownership among Congolese adults was nearly 39 percent in 2022, mostly mobile money wallets.

COD.note: Single author's paper states its views are not the institution's; no institution research centre, consultation role or advisory role stated.

facts.fact: The paper says active mobile money users in the DRC rose from about eight million in 2020 to more than twenty-three million in 2024, citing GSMA, and notes lack of interoperability between providers.

COD.note: No school internet share or curriculum stated.
